verdict.rationale: Formant has an AI assistant and plain-language fleet queries, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions MCP or any way to register external tool servers with that assistant. Its SDKs, APIs, webhooks and custom commands are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
